name: TIME token ERC2771+Multicall address spoofing (thirdweb forwarder)
verdict_reason: No separate attacker transaction exists. Every call into the TIME token via multicall/forwarder in blocks 18700000-18740000 (trace_filter) is either Yoink tx 0xecdd111a... (block 18730463, position 0, 2023-12-06 23:11:59 UTC) or a later copy by a different bot (0x1911be70..., block 18732002, ~5 h later, different calldata, 0.27 WETH). Nothing touching the forwarder/TIME/pool/Yoink contract is in the mempool-dumpster for 2023-12-06 (csv + sourcelog). The tx DeFiHackLabs, CertiK (84.59 ETH) and SharkTeam analyse as "the attack" IS Yoink's tx: 84.59 ETH = 94.513 WETH out - 5 WETH in - 4.923 ETH builder bribe. Yoink was the first mover, not a replay of a hacker. Unknown != none: a private attacker tx that never landed would be invisible.

protocol_loss_usd.note: CertiK ~$188K / 84.6 ETH; SlowMist ~$190K. On-chain: Uniswap V2 TIME/WETH LPs lost 89.513 WETH net (94.513 out, 5 in).

attacker.note: No distinct attacker found. The party labelled "attacker" by DeFiHackLabs is Yoink (EOA 0xfde0d157..., contract 0x6980a47b...).

txs.note: Yoink tx (private: not in mempool-dumpster); listed so that the incident is complete

bots.label: Yoink (first mover, not a replay)

captured.amount: 94.51346258704683 WETH out of TIME/WETH V2 pool 0x760dc1e0..., 5.0 WETH in (net 89.51346258704683); after builder bribe 84.59022214475925 ETH

bots.bribe_rule_check: msg.value 55 < 1000 -> per-mille of profit: 89.51346258704683 * 55/1000 = 4.923240442287576 ETH (exact), per research/bot-re/analysis.md
bots.replay_evidence: bot analysis grammar decode (scripts/bot_re/decode_script.py, ok=True, x=17796049396425000 wei = min profit 0.0178 ETH, f=0, no stores): [CALL TIME.approve(router,max)] [CALL_VALUE WETH.deposit 5 ETH] [CALL UniV2Router.swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens (WETH->TIME)] [CALL Forwarder 0xc82bbe41.execute(req,sig) len 644: req.from=0xa16a5f37..., req.to=TIME, data=multicall([burn(62,227,259,510e18)] + pool address appended)] [CALL pool.sync()] [CALL Router swap TIME->WETH] [UNWRAP]. This is Yoink's own construction, NOT adapted from an attacker tx: there is no earlier attacker call to diff against.
bots.notes: Tx is private (mempool-dumpster has no record). Builder = Flashbots (coinbase 0xdafea492...), no builder refund to Yoink in the block (unlike Ronin/Paraswap). Pool-spoofed burn removed 62,227,259,510 TIME from the pool (Transfer pool->0x0).

other_racers.label: later copy by a different bot
other_racers.evidence: Same forwarder 0xc82bbe41 execute -> TIME multicall -> spoofed pool sender, but req.from differs (0xdaa64b0c... vs 0xa16a5f37...), inner call is transfer() not burn(), tx is a Uniswap Universal-Router-style call (0x3593564c), not the Yoink grammar. Forwarder-call word diff in incidents/time-2023/forwarder_call_diff.json. Independent re-use of the public idea ~5 h after Yoink; not in mempool-dumpster 2023-12-07.

funds_fate.what: Yoink net profit kept in bot contract

Yoink EOA funds escrow with 84.1 ETH

on-chain notice to TIME holders ("you may be able to recover funds from the recent hack here: [contract address]"), sent as calldata to the TIME token; REVERTED (status 0) so it is only visible in the tx input
escrow balance stays exactly 84.1 ETH at blocks 18765364, 18790000, 18900000 (no payouts); Yoink EOA calls owner function 0x9890220b and the contract sends all 84.1 ETH back to the Yoink EOA

relays_answered.others: ultrasound/bloxroute-regulated/agnostic/aestus/titan/ethgas/btcs answered with 0 bids (retention); bloxroute-max-profit, ethical, eden, manifold retired

auction.value_escalation: Baseline bids 0.001-0.28 ETH from -8.6 s to -3.0 s. At t=-2942 ms (2023-12-06T23:11:56.058Z) the Flashbots builder bids 4.953 ETH (80 tx); within 1 s ~8 builders (payload.de, rsync, beaverbuild, Titan, geth-builder) bid 4.7-4.98 ETH: the 4.92 ETH Yoink coinbase payment is in every top bid (contents of losing bids not public; inferred from value level only, label inferred). "I can haz block?" bids 3.60 ETH (13 tx, -2852 ms) then 8.33 ETH (13 tx, -2363 ms; again 14 tx -1318 ms).

highest_bid_not_delivered.note: Higher than the delivered 5.0011 ETH block; relay data does not say why it lost (rejected at simulation or filtered; unknown).

auction.runner_up_below_winner: Flashbots/Titan late bids 5.002-5.006 ETH arrive AFTER the winning submission (t>+139 ms) - too late for the proposer.
auction.builder_refund_note: none in this block (the Flashbots builder keeps 4.923 of Yoink's 4.923+fees; no tx from 0xdafea492 to Yoink)
auction.bot_tx_note: Yoink tx absent from csv and sourcelog of 2023-12-06: private order flow

headline_text: Yoink was the first to exploit TIME's thirdweb forwarder bug, taking 89.5 ETH gross (84.6 ETH after a 4.92 ETH builder tip) from the TIME/WETH pool in one transaction absent from the archive; its later 84.1 ETH 'recovery' escrow paid out nothing and Yoink withdrew it back.

harmonized.verdict_reason: The tx called 'the attack' is Yoink's own; no separate attacker tx exists to diff against.
